notes.title: Cockwork Industries Complete v5.0: 5th Anniversary Edition
notes.content:
v5.0 (Cockwork Industries Complete 5th Anniversary Edition) is a soft remaster that comes with improved animations and sex scenes, a reworked gallery and unlockables system, many other improvents under the hood as well as Simplified Chinese and Polish language versions.

[list]
[*] Sex scenes and dialogue animations were remastered and converted from sprite-based animations to movies, greatly improving their fluidity.
[*] Frame rates for sprite-based character animations in locations and foreplay sequences were greatly improved.
[*] Sex scenes now have synchronized sound effects.
[*] Personnel Files and Secret Archives menus were replaced with Gallery and Achievements menus respectively.
[*] Gallery now contains all visual content (images and animations) available in the game.
[*] Options menu was added containing language selection, particle effects toggle, fullscreen / windowed mode toggle and master volume setting.
[*] Pause menu [ESC] now has access to Load Game, Gallery, Achievements and Options menus. 
[*] Simplified Chinese and Polish language versions were added.
[*] Gallery entries can now be unlocked in Simplified Mode.
[*] Steam achievements are now automatically unlocked as they are achieved in-game.
[*] Game Guide was temporarily removed in order to be updated.
[*] Many small improvements were made and bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 4.17: Kyoko + Diego dialogue skins
notes.content:
With this update we’re adding the remaining dialogue skins (Lady Punk for Kyoko and Handsome Devil for Diego) and implementing the Game Guide into the game.

Lady Punk dialogue skin for Kyoko can be picked up by clicking the boot item in the Lobby:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35983160/3c313d4d3724b04e37c3dea9ba50f95a6561a10e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35983160/9be113c66e6c03c67263d1ad9b27881d7bbb1183.jpg[/img][/url]

Handsome Devil dialogue skin for Diego can be picked up by clicking the trident item in the Machine Room:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35983160/43abc4df1848499bbbb86fa35c3de8393910948a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35983160/7e444ec42437cac2d1ed0195e955fbdc4a04b4e3.jpg[/img][/url]

Upon pickup, a bonus “tease” animation showcasing the skin will also play out.

Some players also requested the ability to view the post-sex and ending images without the interface visible and now we’re making them available. They can now be found in the “Extras” folder inside your game installation folder.

As indicated in the subtitle, this is a final content patch for Cockwork Industries and 4.17 is the true [b]Complete[/b] version of the game. Of course we still might do some small bug fixes if necessary.
On that note, we're still looking for help in squashing the elusive [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1172940/discussions/0/2523653167113443594]"infinite loading" bug[/url]. We're had several players reporting the bug, but so far none have responded when we reached out to do some testing.

We’d like to thank you all for your support and making this game possible. Things we learned throughout the development of [b]Cockwork Industries[/b] will help us bring you better, more engaging and feature-rich games in the future. We’re now focusing our full attention to finishing our recently announced games – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1172940?emclan=103582791465504568&emgid=2451595573086008177][b]Countess in Crimson[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1172940/view/2502261702442871099][b]Forbidden Curiosities[/b][/url].


Till next time!

Digital Seductions Team

notes.title: Patch 4.10: Birthday Girl Andrea dialogue skin
notes.content:
As a final content update to Cockwork Industries we're adding dialogue skins to the game for all love interests. These skins, when active, will change the character's appearance in dialogue animations and portraits.

The first dialogue skin we're introducing is Birthday Girl Andrea, which can be picked up by clicking the ribbon item in the Office:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35983160/838cece14ace3055a27a6c292d45bcf93c326a3f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35983160/ec2168277caacaf44c498ec2215844f8e66f69e6.jpg[/img][/url]

Upon pickup, a bonus "tease" animation showcasing the skin will also play out. Dialogue skins for remaining characters will be added over time.

Before any of you ask, the fact we're adding dialogue skins does not mean we'll be able to add a white protagonist "skin" to the game. There's a reason why we're only changing the characters' appearance in dialogues and not during sex scenes, endings, etc. To add those dialogue skins we already had to roll back some of our development tools to the versions we no longer use, but we decided it's worth it as a token of gratitude to the community. We are well aware of the demand for a white protagonist and it's something we'll certainly have in mind while working on our future games.


[h3]FUTURE CONTENT[/h3]

The dialogue skins are the final content we'll be adding to Cockwork Industries. While we were also considering adding some additional language versions to the game, under current circumstances it proved to be too difficult and we made a hard decision to abandon this idea. While we are blown-away and humbled by the visible demand for additional languages, it isn't something we were prepared for.

We know it's disappointing to many of you but one thing you have to understand is that Digital Seductions is essentially a micro two-man development team with limited resourced both in terms of budgets and workforce. Cockwork Industries was made on a minimal budget and languages other than English were never a consideration prior to the Steam release and we have no localization workflows in place.

Having said that, being on Steam allows up to steadily grow and we'd like to use this opportunity to bring you games with more features, language options, better visuals and audio in the future. We're planning to add some additional language versions to the games we're currently developing, though the choice of languages is yet to be determined. We know we have a lot of fans in China, Japan and South Korea but Asian languages are sadly out of the question for the foreseeable future due to engine limitations.

Digital Seductions Team

notes.title: Patch 4.02: Steam achievements are live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone

Due to popular demand we've integrated Steam achievements into Cockwork Industries Complete!

They are based on in-game Secret Archives achievements, so if you unlocked any Secret Archives rewards you can click "Sync with Steam" button on the game's title screen and synchronization will start.

With this update, we've also added several quality of life improvements to the game (details at the bottom of the page).


[u][b]Why synchronize achievements manually?[/b][/u]

This is because of two reasons:

1. We want to give the opportunity to maintain discretion for those players who don't want to have their Cockwork Industries achievements visible to their Steam friends, which was our initial reasoning behind not including Steam achievements at all in the first place. Thankfully, thanks to manual sync, we can have the best of both worlds.

2. It's the easiest way to provide the ability to add achievements retrospectively for those players who already unlocked some or even all in-game achievements. One click of the button and you're fully synced!


[u][b]Why is there no description for any of the Steam achievements?[/b][/u]

Steam requires to have achievement descriptions be suitable for all ages. Some of our achievement descriptions don't meet that criteria. If you wish to see how you can unlock each achievement, start the game and open the Secret Archives menu - all descriptions are available there are achievement names perfectly match those available in Steam.


[u][b]What’s next?[/b][/u]

Although we’re already hard at work on new games, we’re not yet completely done with Cockwork Industries. Apart from bug fixes (if necessary) we plan to keep adding small, free cosmetic updates over the coming months so you can keep enjoying the game a little bit more!


Enjoy your 40 brand new and shiny Steam achievements :-) !

Digital Seductions Team
